ideas.title: Investigating the Killing of Alex Pretti
ideas.description: This story would investigate the circumstances surrounding the killing of Alex Pretti and the subsequent federal civil rights investigation
ideas.angle: Use of force by law enforcement and accountability
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the killing of Alex Pretti?
What is the status of the federal civil rights investigation?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to shed light on the use of force by law enforcement and the need for accountability. By investigating the circumstances surrounding the killing and the subsequent investigation, we can gain a better understanding of the issues at play and the need for reform.
